_meta.purpose: HOME-BASED BUSINESS validity set (n=50). The actual lead-magnet population: thin public evidence, sole operators, statutory scale caps. Tests the 0.9.0 display_floor change on the population where evidence coverage is genuinely lowest.
_meta.LABEL_SOURCE: PUBLIC LISTING: Simei home studio with nearly 200 five-star reviews on Carousell; every facial includes eyebrow shaping and a shoulder massage; operates an explicit pay-by-session guarantee with no packages or products required.
sources: PUBLIC LISTING: Simei home studio with nearly 200 five-star reviews on Carousell; every facial includes eyebrow shaping and a shoulder massage; operates an explicit pay-by-session guarantee with no packages or products required.
_meta.authoring_note: FORM DATA reconstructed by the analyst from public sources. The LABEL is external (press coverage, published prices, or statute); the form is thinner than a real submission.

form.differentiator: No packages, ever. You pay by session, and every facial includes eyebrow shaping and a shoulder massage at no extra cost.
form.undercut_on: We are one studio in Simei, so customers outside the east have to travel, and one person sets the ceiling on how many we can serve.
form.your_price_point: from S$58, eyebrow shaping and shoulder massage included
form.their_price_point: See the derived competitive set for the category ladder.

tier_0_default.why: Free. Most skincare occasions resolve here.

tier_1_cheap_substitute.why: Same treatment cheaper, no home setting.

tier_2_direct_set.why: Same treatment, same occasion. Home studios compete with chains on price and with housecalls on convenience.

members: chains with brand recall and packages
home studios with strong review counts
tier_3_category_incumbent.why: Each holds a rung: 'the brand', 'the trusted home one', 'the qualified one'.

tier_4_adjacent_crossover.why: Same goal, different authority and price tier.

members: pushy package-selling damaging the category's reputation
tier_6_indirect.why: Reduces willingness to book at all.

derived_competitive_set._rules: HDB/URA Home-Based Business Scheme: small-scale only, operated by residents only, no non-resident employees, no signage or advertising at the premises, no large-scale storage. Permitted: small-scale food (SFA rules; CATERING IS FORBIDDEN), hairdressing/facial/manicure/pedicure/beauty EXCLUDING MASSAGE, private tuition for not more than three students at a time, sewing, freelance creative work.
derived_competitive_set._derivation_method: Derived from the PRODUCT CATEGORY (Facial and skincare treatment), not the owner's list.
